Maya (AE): Quick sync: NovaRetail wants a POC next week. Scope: streaming SDK -> tool calls for moderation + structured JSON for downstream rerank. They hit corporate proxies. Need guidance (handshake, ws fallback, creds) + pricing and security notes.
Jun (SE): I can coordinate. Do they insist on Dedicated for trial? Or will hosted with SOC2 attestation suffice?
Maya (AE): They prefer hosted first but might require Dedicated if KMS/SAML needed.
Ethan (Runtime): Main technical constraints: some requests are ~12k tokens, tail latency target ~350ms. Their proxy closes SSE after ~60s. Recommend websocket fallback + 10s heartbeats for reliability.
Priya (SE): Can you drop a minimal curl + small node ws example I can hand to their infra? Also a sample structured-output schema for their reranker.
Ethan (Runtime): Sure. Handshake (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <EPH>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-3b","max_tokens":16384,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket"}'
```
Websocket (node) fallback snippet:
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer <EPH>'}});
ws.on('open',()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-stream-3b',max_tokens:16384}))); 
setInterval(()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'heartbeat'})),10000);
```
Ethan (Runtime): Stream event for tool call: `event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"mod","args":{"text":"..."},"trace":"nr-01"}`
Ethan (Runtime): Structured output example: `{"choices":[{"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"score\":{\"type\":\"number\"},\"label\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}","value":{"score":0.95,"label":"safe"}}}]}
`
Jun (SE): For client/backpressure advice: window=5 concurrent in-flight messages, heartbeat=10s, reconnect with exponential backoff + jitter. Server recommendations: prefix KV caching for repeated contexts and batch size=16.
Lina (Security): From their security sheet: they ask for SAML and customer KMS support plus logs to SIEM. Hosted path OK if they accept SOC2 attestation PDF. If they need KMS/SAML we move to Dedicated/Private. Ask for their SAML metadata and keypolicy snippet.
Maya (AE): Billing question: how to articulate function/tool call costs?
billing-bot: Tool/function invocation = $0.002 per call + per-token inference fees.
Maya (AE): Good. I'll send the runbook and schedule. POC demo Wed 9am PT. Jun, Ethan, Lina attending. Please confirm readiness by Tue EOD.
Jun (SE): Confirmed, I'll prepare a 1-pager and a small test script that runs over a proxy.
Ethan (Runtime): I'll build a tiny docker image with ws fallback + loader and post image link by Tue.
Lina (Security): I'll request SAML metadata and KMS policy from NovaRetail and confirm SOC2 attestation delivery method.
Maya (AE): Thanks — high priority. If proxy complexity blocks demo, ping me and we loop in eng-sre.
